failure.message: the floor plan's scale cannot be established: the page vote's 1.516396 cm/px is kept, but no reading that owes nothing to it supports it: every value that agrees with it was fitted to it; 3.025381 cm/px, stated by 1 independent reading on 1 chain(s) does not outweigh it twice over. The scales its readings state are 3.025381 cm/px (1 independent, plausible); 1.968313 cm/px (1 independent, plausible); 2.649689 cm/px (0 independent, plausible); 2 printed readings contradict the one it was read at. What is missing: a reading of the printed dimensions that settles one scale — 4 dimension labels were found on 55 dimension lines, and as read they do not: an overall dimension read unambiguously, or two readings on different chains that agree. (the lowest storey covers 7.04 m² against the 75.83 m² the publisher prints — 90.7% apart: the decomposition is not of this building; 12 other readings of the plan were weighed and none survived to a full composition)
